title: Lexio MCP server: read-only access to a vehicle rental account
description:
Description, registry entry and client configuration for the remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server of Lexio, a vehicle rental management software. The server (https://api.lexio.rent/mcp, Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE) exposes 43 read-only tools covering availability, rentals, fleet, customers, pricing and invoices, so an AI assistant can answer questions about a rental company's activity without being able to modify its data.

Documentation: https://lexio.rent/mcp
